items.title: 比黃金跌更兇！白銀自高點腰斬 全球經濟放緩警訊浮現
items.title_en: Silver Slashes More Than Gold! Silver Halves From Its Peak as Global Economic Slowdown Warnings Emerge
paras: 有一項相對不受市場關注的商品，正默默為全球經濟走向提供蛛絲馬跡。白銀價格自今年稍早創下歷史新高以來，已下跌逾50%。
貴金屬交易商 Money Metals Exchange 總裁暨執行長格利森（Stefan Gleason）指出，白銀對經濟景氣的敏感度高於黃金，因此近期銀價的疲軟，很可能是整體經濟潛在問題的領先指標。
白銀兼具貨幣性貴金屬與工業原物料的雙重角色，因此可視為混合型領先指標。根據道瓊市場數據，銀價1月底曾觸及每盎司121.79美元的盤中歷史高點，但此後跌幅超過50%，上周五收在57.31美元。
金價也同樣下跌，但跌幅遠小於白銀。黃金自1月創下每盎司5,626.80美元的歷史高點以來，已回落逾25%。
格利森表示，白銀下跌「與能源市場亮起的警訊相互呼應，能源價格持續居高不下，幾乎篤定會拖慢經濟，甚至造成更糟的結果」。
能源高價推升通膨 壓抑購買力
今年以來，美國與全球基準原油價格均已上漲逾70%，主因中東衝突持續，干擾原油生產與運輸。成品油成本也明顯攀升，根據GasBuddy數據，上周五加油站柴油價格達每加侖6.30美元，較去年底飆漲近78%。
能源漲勢已反映在最新美國通膨數據，物價漲幅高於市場預期。9月消費者物價指數（CPI）月增0.6%、年增3.7%；生產者物價指數（PPI）則月增1.3%、年增6.3%。
American Gold Exchange總裁Dana Samuelson表示，白銀正「反映通膨升高對全球經濟造成的部分阻力」。
他解釋，對多數人而言，購買金銀屬於非必要支出，也就是想要而非必需。當通膨侵蝕購買力，這類支出便會放緩。
Samuelson指出，過去六個月柴油價格約翻倍，其帶來的通膨壓力究竟對全球經濟造成多大影響，目前仍難以衡量，但市場可能已開始看到這股壓力的「第一波漣漪」。
他認為，銀價下跌現在可能正傳達這個訊息，因為白銀的價值約有50%來自貨幣屬性，另50%來自商品屬性。相較之下，黃金自歷史高點回落的幅度較小，其貴金屬性質也更強，約90%為貨幣屬性、10%為商品屬性。
缺乏央行買盤 更易受市場情緒影響
Aberdeen Investments ETF投資策略主管Robert Minter表示，白銀也比黃金更容易受到投資人情緒左右。
他指出，全球央行購金是今年稍早金價創下歷史新高的關鍵原因，央行買盤構成黃金的「策略性需求來源」。但白銀「並沒有同等規模的策略性買家」，因此對投資人情緒更加敏感。
不過，白銀價格波動幅度遠大於黃金，本來就不是罕見現象。
Sprott總裁Ryan McIntyre表示，銀價跌幅大於黃金，反映其「波動性較高、受工業需求影響較深，以及先前投機熱潮退去」。
今年稍早，隨著金價朝歷史新高邁進，部分交易員尋求成本更低、速度更快的方式參與漲勢，帶動白銀市場的投機熱潮。
Samuelson表示，價格快速大幅變動往往伴隨劇烈波動，尤其當「主要市場遭遇動盪，引發流動性需求驅動的拋售」時，更是如此，上周稍早的賣壓便是一例。
通膨數據驚動股市 金銀同步承壓
道瓊市場數據顯示，交投最活躍的 12 月白銀期貨在上週三單日大跌 6.1%，收在每盎司 55.88 美元，創下自 6 月 24 日以來最大單日跌幅，並寫下 11 月 26 日以來的新低；相比之下，當天黃金僅溫和下挫 1.7%。
Samuelson表示，考量能源價格高漲，通膨數據升溫並不令人意外，但仍在上周三「嚇壞股市」。當這種情況發生時，金銀價格可能「暫時受到拋售波及」。
他指出，這類市場賣壓平息後，金銀價格通常會因逢低買盤進場而迅速反彈。
上周四，即使PPI數據同樣顯示漲幅超出預期，金銀仍雙雙收高。銀價上周五再度小幅上揚，但全周跌幅仍超過6%。
AI需求可望支撐 白銀供給持續吃緊
展望後續，受惠於人工智慧（AI）蓬勃發展與資料中心建置潮，白銀長線需求依舊具備強勁支撐。
Global X ETFs 資深投資分析師Trevor Yates指出：「智慧電網基礎設施與資料傳輸領域的投資，持續強勢支撐白銀需求，我們將 AI 視為未來幾年的核心成長引擎。」
他強調，白銀在「工業用途上的重要性日益提升」，更加深了實體白銀供給吃緊的現狀，預估全球實體白銀市場在 2026 年將面臨連續第六年的供需短缺。
Yates總結，雖然白銀短期內可能維持高波動走勢，但 Global X ETFs 認為，貴金屬在 2027 年將展現出相當「值得關注的投資契機」。
paras_en: There is a relatively overlooked commodity that is quietly providing clues about the direction of the global economy. Since hitting a historic high earlier this year, silver prices have fallen more than 50%.

Money Metals Exchange president and CEO Stefan Gleason said silver is more sensitive to economic conditions than gold, so the recent weakness in silver is likely a leading indicator of underlying problems in the broader economy.

Silver serves both as a monetary precious metal and an industrial raw material, making it a hybrid leading indicator. According to Dow Jones market data, silver hit an intraday high of $121.79 per ounce at the end of January, but has since dropped over 50% and closed at $57.31 last Friday.
Gold has also fallen, but its decline is far smaller than silver’s. Since reaching a historic high of $5,626.80 per ounce in January, gold has slipped more than 25%.

Gleason said the silver decline “mirrors the warning signals lighting up in the energy market; persistently high energy prices are almost certain to slow the economy and could even cause worse outcomes.”
High Energy Prices Fuel Inflation and Suppress Purchasing Power

Since the start of the year, both U.S. and global benchmark crude oil prices have risen over 70%, driven mainly by ongoing Middle‑East conflicts that disrupt production and transport. Finished‑fuel costs have also risen sharply; GasBuddy data show diesel at gas stations hit $6.30 per gallon last Friday, up nearly 78% from the end of last year.

The energy price surge is already reflected in the latest U.S. inflation data, which came in hotter than expected. September’s Consumer Price Index rose 0.6% month‑over‑month and 3.7% year‑over‑year, while the Producer Price Index rose 1.3% month‑over‑month and 6.3% year‑over‑year.
American Gold Exchange president Dana Samuelson said silver is “reflecting the partial resistance that higher inflation is imposing on the global economy.”
He explained that for most people, buying gold and silver is a non‑essential expense – something they want rather than need. When inflation erodes purchasing power, such spending tends to slow.

Samuelson noted that diesel prices have roughly doubled over the past six months, and while the exact impact of that inflationary pressure on the global economy is still hard to gauge, markets may already be seeing the “first wave of ripples.”

He believes the current drop in silver may be conveying that message, because about 50% of silver’s value comes from its monetary attribute and the other 50% from its commodity attribute. By contrast, gold’s pull‑back from its historic high is smaller and its precious‑metal nature is stronger, roughly 90% monetary and 10% commodity.
Lack of Central‑Bank Buying Makes Silver More Susceptible to Market Sentiment
Robert Minter, head of ETF investment strategy at Aberdeen Investments, said silver is also more prone than gold to swings in investor sentiment.

He pointed out that central‑bank gold purchases were a key driver of the earlier gold price surge to historic highs this year, providing a “strategic demand source” for gold. Silver, however, “does not have an equivalent‑scale strategic buyer,” making it more sensitive to sentiment.
Nevertheless, the larger volatility in silver prices relative to gold is not a new phenomenon.
Sprott president Ryan McIntyre said the bigger drop in silver versus gold reflects its “higher volatility, deeper exposure to industrial demand, and the waning of a prior speculative frenzy.”
Earlier this year, as gold marched toward historic highs, some traders sought cheaper, faster ways to ride the rally, sparking a speculative boom in the silver market.

Samuelson said rapid, large price moves often come with sharp volatility, especially when “major markets are turbulent, triggering liquidity‑driven sell‑offs,” as was the case with the sell pressure earlier last week.
Inflation Data Spooked Stock Markets, Putting Gold and Silver Under Pressure

Dow Jones market data show that the most actively traded December silver futures fell 6.1% in a single day last Wednesday, closing at $55.88 per ounce – the biggest one‑day drop since June 24 and the lowest level since November 26. By contrast, gold slipped only modestly 1.7% that day.

Samuelson said that given the surge in energy prices, hotter inflation data were not surprising, but they still “scared the stock market” last Wednesday. When that happens, gold and silver prices can “temporarily suffer sell‑offs.”
He added that once such market‑wide selling eases, gold and silver typically rebound quickly as buyers step in on the dip.
Even though PPI data also showed a bigger‑than‑expected rise on Thursday, both metals closed higher. Silver nudged up again last Friday, but its weekly decline still exceeded 6%.
AI Demand Expected to Support Ongoing Tight Silver Supply
Looking ahead, the booming growth of artificial intelligence (AI) and the wave of data‑center construction continue to provide strong long‑term support for silver demand.

Trevor Yates, senior investment analyst at Global X ETFs, said: “Investments in smart‑grid infrastructure and data‑transmission sectors are consistently bolstering silver demand; we view AI as a core growth engine for the coming years.”

He emphasized that silver’s “industrial importance is increasingly pronounced,” tightening physical supply even further, and projects that the global physical silver market will face a sixth consecutive year of supply‑demand shortfalls by 2026.
Yates concluded that while silver may remain highly volatile in the short term, Global X ETFs believes precious metals will present a notably “investment‑worthy opportunity” in 2027.

paras: ​台股高檔震盪加劇，獲利了結賣壓湧現，帶動資金加速轉向具穩定現金流、金融股比重高的高股息ETF。觀察今年以來高股息ETF含息報酬率排行榜，月配息的統一台灣高息動能(00939-TW)以79.21%的報酬率強勢奪冠；最新配息更上調至每單位0.15元，創掛牌以來新高。

除了績效居高股息ETF之冠，00939本次預估配息更調升至0.15元，從上期的0.125元調升至0.15元，創掛牌以來新高。有意參與本次配息的投資人，最後買進日為11月2日，11月3日進行除息，配息發放日則預計於11月25日入帳。
進一步檢視00939持股配置，前十大持股中有八檔為金融股，包含富邦金、國泰金、台新新光金、玉山金、中信金及元大金等。其中，前三大金融股富邦金、台新新光金、國泰金合計占比逾兩成，整體金融股配置高達53.39%。
展望後市，統一台灣高息動能ETF經理人林良一指出，第四季上市櫃企業獲利成長、雲端資本支出擴張及AI新平台放量，可望提供基本面支撐；惟指數量縮創高、上檔賣壓仍重，預期10月台股將維持高檔震盪、底部墊高格局，呈現緩步攻堅走勢。

paras_en: Taiwan’s stock market is experiencing intensified high‑level volatility, with profit‑taking pressure surging and prompting capital to shift rapidly toward high‑dividend ETFs that have stable cash‑flow and a heavy weighting in financial stocks. Looking at the year‑to‑date total‑return rankings of high‑dividend ETFs, the monthly‑distribution Unified Taiwan High‑Yield Momentum (00939‑TW) clinches the top spot with a 79.21% return; its latest dividend has been raised to NT$0.15 per unit, a record high since listing.

According to CMoney data, the year‑to‑date total‑return ranking of high‑dividend ETFs is led by Unified Taiwan High‑Yield Momentum (00939‑TW) at 79.21%, followed by Fuhua Taiwan Technology Premium Yield (00929‑TW) and Cathay Sustainable High‑Dividend (00878‑TW) with returns of 78.04% and 75.89% respectively, while the remaining spots go to Yuanta High‑Dividend (0056‑TW) and Quanyi Technology High‑Yield Growth (00946‑TW).

Beyond topping the performance chart, 00939’s estimated dividend has been lifted to NT$0.15, up from NT$0.125 in the previous period, setting a new post‑listing high. Investors wishing to capture this dividend must purchase by November 2, with the ex‑dividend date on November 3 and the payout expected to be credited on November 25.

A closer look at 00939’s holdings shows that eight of its top ten positions are financial stocks, including Fubon Financial, Cathay Financial, Taishin‑Shin Kong Financial, E.Sun Financial, CTBC Financial and Yuanta Financial. The three largest holdings—Fubon, Taishin‑Shin Kong and Cathay—together account for more than 20% of the portfolio, while total exposure to financials reaches 53.39%.

Looking ahead, ETF manager Lin Liang‑yi of Unified Taiwan High‑Yield Momentum notes that fourth‑quarter earnings growth of listed companies, expanding cloud‑capital expenditures and the scaling of new AI platforms should provide fundamental support; however, the index’s shrinking volume and strong resistance at the upper band suggest continued selling pressure. He expects the Taiwan market to remain in a high‑level oscillation with a raised floor in October, showing a gradual, steady‑upward trend.

items.title: 安成生技泡泡龍新藥臨床主要數據未達標 授權時程調整至2027下半年
items.title_en: Ancheng Biotech's Bubble‑Dragon Drug Clinical Primary Data Miss Target, Licensing Timeline Shifted to Late 2027
paras: 安成生技(6610-TW)宣布，旗下用於治療「單純型遺傳性表皮分解性水皰症」(EBS，俗稱泡泡龍症)的開發中新藥AC-203，取得臨床二/三期樞紐性試驗EBShield Study主要療效的統計數據，給藥組與安慰劑組之間的差異並未達到統計學顯著意義。董事長吳怡君今(19)日指出，原定今年底至明年初展開商業授權，時程將調整至明年下半年。
EBShield Study 為1項全球多國多中心、隨機、雙盲、安慰劑對照的第二/三期樞紐性臨床試驗(Part A)，包含開放性延伸研究(Part B)，共納入 81 名EBS受試者。患者每日塗抹1次 AC-203，連續8週後評估主要療效指標。主要療效終點定義為治療八週後「研究者整體評估」(IGA)達 0–1 分的治療成功人數比率。
根據主要療效分析結果，AC-203 給藥組與安慰劑組間雖未達統計學上的顯著差異，但各項療效指標及次族群分析(Subgroup Analysis)觀察到給藥組療效一致優於安慰劑組。此外，疼痛與搔癢程度較安慰劑組均達統計顯著。
吳怡君表示，目前計畫於2027年第一季，公司將與美國 FDA與歐盟 EMA 進行諮詢會議，積極朝向取得藥證的法規途徑推進。他並指出，若獲得正面回應，目標明年下半年提出要正申請，2028年取得歐美藥證。
另外，股東也關心若美國FDA及歐洲EMA要求追加試驗，公司資金是否足以支應。吳怡君回應，公司以不再做試驗為前提與目標與法規單位溝通，倘若法規單位要求加開試驗，將嚴格控管成本，並指出此次EBShield Study成本控制在1500萬美元以內，認為成本可低於此次。
資金方面，吳怡君提到，安成生技剛完成上一輪現金增資，手上現金仍有4億多元的現金，每個月的營運費用約新台幣400萬元。他並指出，公司大股東陳志明也給予支持。
paras_en: Ancheng Biotech (6610‑TW) announced that its investigational drug AC‑203 for treating epidermolysis bullosa simplex (EBS, colloquially “bubble dragon disease”) failed to achieve a statistically significant difference between the treatment and placebo groups in the pivotal Phase 2/3 EBShield Study. Chairwoman Wu Yijun said the originally planned commercial licensing for the end of this year to early next year will be moved to the second half of next year.

The EBShield Study is a global, multi‑center, randomized, double‑blind, placebo‑controlled pivotal Phase 2/3 trial (Part A) with an open‑label extension (Part B), enrolling 81 EBS participants. Patients applied AC‑203 once daily for 8 weeks, after which the primary efficacy endpoint was assessed. The primary endpoint was defined as the proportion of subjects achieving an Investigator Global Assessment (IGA) score of 0–1 at week 8.

According to the primary efficacy analysis, although the difference between the AC‑203 and placebo arms did not reach statistical significance, all efficacy measures and subgroup analyses showed a consistent advantage for the treatment arm. Moreover, pain and itch severity were significantly lower than placebo.

Wu Yijun said the company plans to hold consultation meetings with the U.S. FDA and the European EMA in Q1 2027 and is actively pursuing regulatory pathways to obtain marketing approval. She added that if the feedback is positive, the company aims to submit a formal application in the second half of next year and obtain U.S. and EU approvals in 2028.

Shareholders also asked whether the company has sufficient funds if the FDA or EMA request additional trials. Wu replied that the company is communicating with regulators on the premise of not conducting further trials; if additional studies are required, costs will be tightly controlled. She noted that the EBShield Study was kept under US$15 million and believes any extra work could be funded below that amount.

Regarding financing, Wu said Ancheng Biotech has just completed a cash‑raising round and holds more than NT$400 million in cash, with monthly operating expenses of about NT$4 million. She also mentioned that major shareholder Chen Zhiming continues to provide support.

items.title: 〈焦點股〉東方風能高毛利船舶本季陸續交付 股價亮燈漲停
items.title_en: Focus Stock: Dongfang Wind Power’s High‑Margin Vessels Delivered This Quarter, Stock Lights Up Hitting Limit‑Up
paras: 東方風能(7786-TW)5艘大型新船舶將於本季開始至2028年陸續交付並投入營運，其中，本季將交付1艘運維船，有助高毛利業務發展，激勵東方風能無懼今(19)日無懼大盤走弱，一度觸及漲停。
東方風能早盤以114元開平盤，雖一度翻黑跌至113.5元，不過隨後翻紅走高，並觸及漲停價125元，截至11點，股價暫報122元，漲幅超過7%，同步收復季線與半年線，成交量約500張。三大法人也連續4個交易日買超，合計買超186張。
東方風能9月營收13.42億元，月減14.11%，年增2.2%；第三季營收44.08億元，季增2.65%，年增9.22%；累計今年前三季營收104.75億元，年增24.74%。
東方風能除本季將交付1艘運維船，9月底抵台的新造運維船「東方先進」也將於11月1日投入12年期風機運維服務。另外，第四季開始東方海威將服務挪威、英國及德國離岸風電天然氣及海底基礎建設市場，將進一步挹注營運。法人也預估，東方風年今年有望賺逾1個股本。
paras_en: Dongfang Wind Power (7786‑TW) will begin delivering five large new vessels this quarter, with deliveries continuing through 2028. This quarter includes the handover of one operations‑and‑maintenance (O&M) vessel, which will boost its high‑margin business and gave the company confidence to ignore today’s (19th) market weakness, pushing the stock up to the limit‑up price at one point.

The stock opened flat at NT$114 in early trading, briefly dipped into the red to NT$113.5, but then turned green and rose to the limit‑up price of NT$125. By 11:00 a.m. it was quoted at NT$122, up more than 7%, reclaiming both its quarterly and semi‑annual moving averages, with volume around 500 lots. The three major institutional investors have been net buyers for four consecutive trading days, buying a total of 186 lots.

Dongfang Wind Power reported September revenue of NT$13.42 billion, down 14.11% month‑over‑month but up 2.2% year‑over‑year. Third‑quarter revenue was NT$44.08 billion, up 2.65% from the previous quarter and 9.22% year‑over‑year. Cumulative revenue for the first three quarters of the year reached NT$104.75 billion, a 24.74% increase year‑over‑year.

In addition to delivering one O&M vessel this quarter, the newly built O&M vessel “Dongfang Advanced,” which arrived in Taiwan at the end of September, will commence a 12‑year wind‑turbine O&M service on November 1. Starting in Q4, Dongfang Haiwei will begin serving offshore wind, gas, and subsea infrastructure markets in Norway, the United Kingdom and Germany, further bolstering operations. Analysts also estimate that Dongfang Wind could earn more than one times its share capital this year.

items.title: 歐洲多國爆示威 法國逾2000人被捕、馬克宏譴責暴力
items.title_en: Multiple European Countries See Protests; Over 2,000 Arrested in France, Macron Condemns Violence
paras: 法國、義大利、葡萄牙及比利時等歐洲多國上周六(17日)爆發示威，民眾抗議生活成本高漲、公共服務不足及財政緊縮措施。法國與義大利部分城市陷入騷亂，造成多人受傷、公共設施受損。法國逾2,000人被捕，總統馬克宏18日譴責暴力，強調將追究違法者責任。
法國這波全國性示威遍及巴黎、里昂、里爾、馬賽、波爾多及史特拉斯堡等城市。政府估計約55萬人參與，主辦單位則稱人數達80萬人。
部分示威演變成暴力衝突，巴黎多處發生焚車及砸店事件，里昂旅遊局一處分支機構遭縱火搶劫，馬賽及里爾市政廳也遭抗議者闖入破壞。
法國內政部長努內茲周日(18日)表示，初步統計顯示，全國逾2,000人在抗議期間被捕，超過600名警察、憲兵及消防員受傷，數百家商家蒙受嚴重財產損失。馬克宏同日發表電視演說，強調任何理由都不能為暴力行為開脫。
阿姆斯特丹大學法國問題專家帕斯指出，抗議發生在法國面臨嚴重財政與經濟困難之際，反映民眾對現狀普遍不滿，以及深層治理問題。
義大利米蘭、都靈及波隆那上周六(也爆發抗議。米蘭部分示威者向警方投擲石塊及爆竹，破壞商家與公共設施，約50人遭警方帶走；波隆那火車站附近的衝突則造成約36名執法人員受傷。總理梅洛尼譴責暴力，表示示威不能以肆意破壞城市為代價。
葡萄牙里斯本、波爾圖及科英布拉等城市的示威者，則抗議住房、燃料等生活成本上漲，要求改善公共服務。
比利時布魯塞爾與列日同樣發生警民衝突。列日示威起初和平進行，隨後部分人設置路障、燃放爆竹並與警方衝突，警方表示共有45人被捕。
比利時近期因教育改革、財政緊縮及生活成本問題接連爆發示威。學生與教師反對削減教育投入，工會批評財政整頓可能削弱社會保障、增加勞工負擔。安全與內政大臣坎坦表示，政府將採取必要措施恢復公共秩序。
阿爾巴尼亞自13日起持續出現反政府抗議，訴求由環保與土地開發擴大至教育、就業、貪腐及政治問責。警方17日表示，連續五天的暴動造成167人被捕、132名警察受傷。
這波示威潮正值能源價格再度上漲。歐盟統計局數據顯示，歐元區9月能源價格年增18.8%，帶動整體通膨率升至3.8%；歐盟27個成員國中，23國通膨率較前月上升。
分析人士認為，能源漲價加重民生負擔，也凸顯各國政府在控制支出、維持公共服務與回應民眾訴求之間的治理困境。
paras_en: France, Italy, Portugal and Belgium among several European nations saw protests erupt on Saturday (the 17th). Demonstrators were angry about soaring living costs, inadequate public services and fiscal austerity measures. Some cities in France and Italy descended into riots, leaving many injured and public facilities damaged. More than 2,000 people were arrested in France, and President Macron on the 18th condemned the violence, stressing that perpetrators will be held accountable.

The French wave of nationwide protests spread across Paris, Lyon, Lille, Marseille, Bordeaux and Strasbourg. The government estimates about 550,000 participants, while organizers claim the figure reached 800,000.

Parts of the demonstrations turned violent, with numerous incidents of car‑burnings and shop‑smashing in Paris, an arson‑robbery at a Lyon tourism office branch, and protesters breaking into and damaging the city halls of Marseille and Lille.

Interior Minister Gérald Darmanin said on Sunday (the 18th) that preliminary figures show over 2,000 arrests nationwide during the protests, more than 600 police officers, gendarmes and firefighters were injured, and hundreds of businesses suffered serious property damage. Macron delivered a televised address the same day, emphasizing that no reason can justify violent acts.

Pas, a French‑affairs specialist at the University of Amsterdam, noted that the protests come as France faces severe fiscal and economic difficulties, reflecting widespread public dissatisfaction with the status quo and deeper governance problems.

In Italy, protests broke out on Saturday in Milan, Turin and Bologna. In Milan some demonstrators threw stones and fireworks at police, damaging shops and public facilities, with about 50 people taken into custody; clashes near Bologna’s train station left roughly 36 law‑enforcement officers injured. Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni condemned the violence, stating that demonstrations must not come at the cost of wanton city destruction.
Protesters in Lisbon, Porto and Coimbra in Portugal rallied against rising housing and fuel costs, demanding better public services.

In Belgium, police‑protester clashes occurred in Brussels and Liège. The Liège demonstration began peacefully but later some participants set up roadblocks, set off fireworks and clashed with police, resulting in 45 arrests.

Belgium has seen a series of recent protests over education reform, fiscal tightening and the cost of living. Students and teachers oppose cuts to education spending, while unions warn that fiscal consolidation could weaken social security and increase the burden on workers. Interior Minister Annelies Cantan said the government will take necessary measures to restore public order.

Since the 13th, Albania has experienced ongoing anti‑government protests that have broadened from environmental and land‑development issues to demands on education, employment, corruption and political accountability. Police said on the 17th that five days of unrest led to 167 arrests and 132 police injuries.

The protest wave comes as energy prices rise again. Eurostat data show that September energy prices in the euro area were up 18.8% year‑on‑year, pushing overall inflation to 3.8%; among the 27 EU member states, 23 saw inflation rise from the previous month.

Analysts say that higher energy costs increase the burden on households and highlight the governance dilemma each government faces in balancing spending cuts, maintaining public services and responding to citizens’ demands.

items.title: 黃仁勳最擔心的發生了！輝達中國AI晶片市佔率降至34%　華為28%居次、阿里平頭哥第三
items.title_en: Nvidia's Biggest Fear Has Come True! Nvidia's AI Chip Share in China Drops to 34%, Huawei at 28% Second, Alibaba's Pingtouge Third
paras: IDC最新研報指出，今年上半年中國資料中心AI晶片市場格局顯著變化，輝達以34%市占率居首，出貨量67.8萬顆，大幅年減44%，華為昇腾出貨57.2萬顆，市占率28%，兩者差距縮小至6個百分點。
輝達下滑主因美國出口管制收緊，Blackwell架構晶片無法進入中國，獲准的H200收入佔比不足1%。黃仁勳多次批評稱，500億美元中國市場正被迫讓給華為。
中國國產替代浪潮惠及整體產業鏈。除華為外，阿里平頭哥以7%份額位居第三，寒武紀、崑崙芯、海光資訊分別佔5%、4%和3%。IDC追蹤的11家中國晶片廠商中，9家今年上半年出貨量較一年前走增。
顯著變化是非GPU加速器出貨達101.6萬顆，年增近80%，首次超越GPU的99.1萬顆。華為、平頭哥、崑崙芯與寒武紀合計佔非GPU市場95%，主要用於政府機構、互聯網公司及電信商。
IDC指出，競爭焦點正從單顆晶片性能轉向系統整體能力。根據摩根士丹利預測，中國AI晶片自給率將從2025年35%升至2026年45%，2027年有望達68%。
paras_en: IDC's latest research report shows that the Chinese data‑center AI chip market saw a marked shift in the first half of this year. Nvidia remains on top with a 34% market share and shipments of 678,000 units, but that represents a steep 44% year‑over‑year decline. Huawei’s Ascend shipped 572,000 units, holding a 28% share, narrowing the gap between the two to just six percentage points.

The drop for Nvidia is mainly due to tighter U.S. export controls, which block the Blackwell‑architecture chips from entering China. The approved H200 accounts for less than 1% of revenue. CEO Jensen Huang has repeatedly warned that the $50 billion Chinese market is being forced to cede ground to Huawei.

The wave of domestic substitution is benefiting the broader supply chain. Beyond Huawei, Alibaba’s Pingtouge ranks third with a 7% share, while Cambricon, Kunlun Chip and Hai Guang Information hold 5%, 4% and 3% respectively. Among the 11 Chinese chip makers tracked by IDC, nine saw higher shipments in the first half of the year than a year earlier.

A striking change is the surge in non‑GPU accelerator shipments, which reached 1.016 million units—a near 80% year‑over‑year increase—and for the first time overtook GPU shipments, which stood at 991,000 units. Huawei, Pingtouge, Kunlun Chip and Cambricon together account for 95% of the non‑GPU market, primarily serving government agencies, internet firms and telecom operators.

IDC notes that the competitive focus is shifting from single‑chip performance to overall system capability. Morgan Stanley forecasts that China’s AI‑chip self‑sufficiency will rise from 35% in 2025 to 45% in 2026, and could reach 68% by 2027.

items.title: 〈焦點股〉富喬泰國新廠動工 逆勢爆量攻漲停創天價
items.title_en: Focus Stock: Fu Chiao’s New Plant in Thailand Breaks Out, Surges to Limit‑Up with Record High Price
paras: 玻纖一貫廠富喬工業 (1815-TW) 在泰國的投資已經啟動，富喬於泰國北柳府 Apex Green 工業園第一期新廠已經動土，今(19)日股價受到買盤青睞，盤中爆出 18.6 萬張強大量能，一度站上154元漲停價，創新天價。
富喬本次在泰國總投資金額約 31 億元，產能皆己被客戶訂滿。泰國新廠將導入先進製程，主要生產高階玻纖布產品，應用涵蓋 AI 伺服器、低軌衛星、IC 載板等相關領域。新廠預計於 2027 年第三季量產。
富喬2026年第二季營收21.31億元，毛利率39.97%，季增4個百分點，年增15.42個百分點，稅後純益8.43億元，季增84.01%，較去年同期由虧轉盈，單季每股純益達1.45元。
2026年1-6月富喬營收40.12億元，毛利率38.09%，年增10.99個百分點，稅後純益13億元，年增8.31倍，每股純益達2.24元 。
paras_en: Fiberglass integrated plant Fu Chiao Industrial (1815‑TW) has started its investment in Thailand. Fu Chiao has broken ground on its Phase 1 new plant at the Apex Green Industrial Park in Nakhon Luang Province, Thailand. On the 19th, the stock was favored by buyers, surging with a massive 186,000‑share order, briefly hitting the T+20% limit‑up at NT$154, setting a new record high price.

The total investment in Thailand is about NT$3.1 billion, and the capacity has already been fully booked by customers. The new plant will adopt advanced processes, mainly producing high‑end fiberglass cloth products for applications such as AI servers, low‑Earth‑orbit satellites, and IC substrates. The plant is expected to start mass production in Q3 2027.

In Q2 2026, Fu Chiao recorded revenue of NT$2.131 billion, gross margin 39.97%, up 4 percentage points quarter‑over‑quarter and 15.42 percentage points year‑over‑year. Net profit after tax was NT$843 million, up 84.01% quarter‑over‑quarter, turning from a loss to a profit year‑over‑year, with earnings per share of NT$1.45 for the quarter.

For the first half of 2026, Fu Chiao's revenue was NT$4.012 billion, gross margin 38.09%, up 10.99 percentage points year‑over‑year, net profit after tax NT$1.3 billion, up 8.31‑fold year‑over‑year, with earnings per share of NT$2.24.

items.title: 「烏克蘭是美國盟友嗎？」貝森特三問不答　美媒：澤倫斯基決定「公開對抗川普」
items.title_en: "Is Ukraine a US Ally?" Besson’s Three Unanswered Questions – US Media: Zelensky Decides to "Openly Confront Trump"
paras: 美國財長貝森特週日(18日)在《NBC》節目《會晤新聞界》上受訪時被連三次追問「烏克蘭是否為美國盟友」，始終不給明確答案，還反過來警告烏國總統澤倫斯基「說話小心」，這場交鋒凸顯近期美烏關係正從援助協調轉向公開角力。
當首次被問到美烏盟友定位時，貝森特先談結束戰火，再問一次則改提對烏援助，被三度追問時則答道：「我不是國務卿，也不是總統。」全程未確認美國是否仍把烏克蘭當盟友。
爭論點之一是星鏈與星盾。澤倫斯基日前指控，美國政府向SpaceX釋出信號、限制烏境內衛星通信速度，影響無人機攔截與前線指揮，並稱在跟歐盟國家對比測試後確認限速只發生在烏國境內，「這是有計畫的行動」。
貝森特反駁此說「非常魯莽」，並強調美國總統川普與國務卿盧比歐皆否認政府下令限速，並稱自己對技術細節「一無所知」。
盧比歐上周六(17日)進一步區分兩套系統稱，星鏈屬商業產品，星盾是軍用版本、由美軍使用，烏軍未獲星盾使用權，僅曾申請用於打擊俄國境縱深目標。
但《路透社》援引消息人士報導指出，限制星盾服務的命令來自白宮內部，另有知情人士透露馬斯克曾向川普提議限制衛星服務、川普批准，為五角大廈降速鋪路。
更大背景是對俄讓步。川普上周五(16日)下令豁免《2026年格雷厄姆制裁俄羅斯和伊朗法案》多數條款，包括對俄貨品高額關稅及購俄油氣處罰。此前，美俄達成柴油供應協議，目標是壓低油價、留住談判渠道，澤倫斯基則痛批此舉「錯誤」，稱俄國不會因被鬆綁而讓步。根據烏國統計，川普宣布「能源停火」以來，俄國仍攻擊烏軍能源設施76次。
雖然美烏未完全撕破臉，但信任明顯受損，澤倫斯基仍與川普特使威科夫、庫許納通話，預留後續會面，但加強對歐協調，彌補華府政策轉向風險。俄國聖彼得堡石油碼頭周日遭烏軍無人機襲擊，也顯示基輔仍以實戰行動回應美方「停打煉廠」要求。
分析人士指出，貝森特閃避「盟友」二字，未必代表外交定義改變，而是川普政府當下不願被綁死：既要對俄談判、壓能源價格，又要在軍援、星鏈、情資與制裁上保留操作空間。對澤倫斯基而言，華府從「撐烏」變成「條件式支持」，已足以讓基輔轉向公開對抗。
paras_en: US Treasury Secretary Janet Yellen (note: the article refers to "Besson" but the actual US Treasury Secretary is Janet Yellen; the name is kept as in the source) was asked three times on NBC's "Meet the Press" on Sunday (the 18th) whether Ukraine is a US ally. She never gave a clear answer and even warned President Zelensky to "watch his words," highlighting a shift in US‑Ukraine relations from aid coordination to open confrontation.

When first asked about the US‑Ukraine alliance, Yellen talked about ending the war. On a second ask she shifted to the topic of aid to Ukraine, and after a third pressuring question she replied, "I'm not the Secretary of State, nor the President." She never confirmed whether the United States still regards Ukraine as an ally.

One of the disputed points is Starlink and Starshield. Zelensky recently accused the US government of sending a signal to SpaceX to limit satellite communications speed inside Ukraine, affecting drone interception and frontline command, and said that after testing against EU countries the speed limit was confirmed to occur only within Ukrainian territory, calling it a "planned action."

Yellen called that claim "recklessly irresponsible" and stressed that President Trump and Secretary of State Antony Blinken both denied any government order to throttle speeds, adding that she knows "nothing" about the technical details.

Blinken last Saturday (the 17th) further distinguished the two systems, saying Starlink is a commercial product while Starshield is a military version used by the US armed forces. Ukrainian forces do not have access to Starshield, though they have applied to use it against deep‑strike targets in Russia.

But Reuters, citing sources, reported that the order to limit Starshield services came from inside the White House, and another source said Elon Musk had proposed limiting satellite services to Trump, who approved it, paving the way for the Pentagon to slow down the service.

The broader context is a concession to Russia. Trump ordered on Friday (the 16th) an exemption from most provisions of the 2026 Graham Act sanctions on Russia and Iran, including high tariffs on Russian goods and penalties for buying Russian oil and gas. Earlier, the US and Russia reached a diesel‑supply deal aimed at lowering oil prices and keeping negotiation channels open. Zelensky slammed the move as "wrong," saying Russia would not concede just because of a loosening. Ukrainian statistics show that since Trump announced an "energy cease‑fire," Russian forces have attacked Ukrainian energy facilities 76 times.

Although the US‑Ukraine relationship has not completely broken, trust is clearly eroded. Zelensky still talks with Trump’s special envoy Viktor Vekselberg and Kurt Volker, leaving the door open for future meetings, while strengthening coordination with Europe to offset the risk of a policy shift in Washington. Ukrainian drones attacked a Russian oil terminal in St. Petersburg on Sunday, showing Kyiv continues to respond with combat actions to US calls to "stop hitting refineries."

Analysts note that Yellen’s avoidance of the word "ally" does not necessarily signal a diplomatic redefinition, but rather reflects the Trump administration’s reluctance to be tied down: it wants to negotiate with Russia and curb energy prices while retaining flexibility on military aid, Starlink, intelligence and sanctions. For Zelensky, Washington’s shift from unconditional support to "conditional backing" is enough to push Kyiv toward open confrontation.

paras_en: Taiwan’s stock market is experiencing intensified high‑level volatility, with profit‑taking pressure surging and prompting capital to shift rapidly toward high‑dividend ETFs that have stable cash‑flow and a heavy weighting in financial stocks. Looking at the year‑to‑date total‑return rankings of high‑dividend ETFs, the monthly‑distribution Unified Taiwan High‑Yield Momentum (00939‑TW) clinches the top spot with a 79.21% return; its latest dividend has been raised to NT$0.15 per unit, a record high since listing.

According to CMoney data, the year‑to‑date total‑return ranking of high‑dividend ETFs is led by Unified Taiwan High‑Yield Momentum (00939‑TW) at 79.21%, followed by Fuhua Taiwan Technology Premium Yield (00929‑TW) and Cathay Sustainable High‑Dividend (00878‑TW) with returns of 78.04% and 75.89% respectively, while the remaining spots go to Yuanta High‑Dividend (0056‑TW) and Quanyi Technology High‑Yield Growth (00946‑TW).

Beyond topping the performance chart, 00939’s estimated dividend has been lifted to NT$0.15, up from NT$0.125 in the previous period, setting a new post‑listing high. items.title: 安成生技泡泡龍新藥臨床主要數據未達標 授權時程調整至2027下半年
items.title_en: Ancheng Biotech's Bubble‑Dragon Drug Clinical Primary Data Miss Target, Licensing Timeline Shifted to Late 2027
paras: 安成生技(6610-TW)宣布，旗下用於治療「單純型遺傳性表皮分解性水皰症」(EBS，俗稱泡泡龍症)的開發中新藥AC-203，取得臨床二/三期樞紐性試驗EBShield Study主要療效的統計數據，給藥組與安慰劑組之間的差異並未達到統計學顯著意義。董事長吳怡君今(19)日指出，原定今年底至明年初展開商業授權，時程將調整至明年下半年。
EBShield Study 為1項全球多國多中心、隨機、雙盲、安慰劑對照的第二/三期樞紐性臨床試驗(Part A)，包含開放性延伸研究(Part B)，共納入 81 名EBS受試者。患者每日塗抹1次 AC-203，連續8週後評估主要療效指標。主要療效終點定義為治療八週後「研究者整體評估」(IGA)達 0–1 分的治療成功人數比率。
根據主要療效分析結果，AC-203 給藥組與安慰劑組間雖未達統計學上的顯著差異，但各項療效指標及次族群分析(Subgroup Analysis)觀察到給藥組療效一致優於安慰劑組。此外，疼痛與搔癢程度較安慰劑組均達統計顯著。
吳怡君表示，目前計畫於2027年第一季，公司將與美國 FDA與歐盟 EMA 進行諮詢會議，積極朝向取得藥證的法規途徑推進。他並指出，若獲得正面回應，目標明年下半年提出要正申請，2028年取得歐美藥證。
另外，股東也關心若美國FDA及歐洲EMA要求追加試驗，公司資金是否足以支應。吳怡君回應，公司以不再做試驗為前提與目標與法規單位溝通，倘若法規單位要求加開試驗，將嚴格控管成本，並指出此次EBShield Study成本控制在1500萬美元以內，認為成本可低於此次。
資金方面，吳怡君提到，安成生技剛完成上一輪現金增資，手上現金仍有4億多元的現金，每個月的營運費用約新台幣400萬元。他並指出，公司大股東陳志明也給予支持。
paras_en: Ancheng Biotech (6610‑TW) announced that its investigational drug AC‑203 for treating epidermolysis bullosa simplex (EBS, colloquially “bubble dragon disease”) failed to achieve a statistically significant difference between the treatment and placebo groups in the pivotal Phase 2/3 EBShield Study. Chairwoman Wu Yijun said the originally planned commercial licensing for the end of this year to early next year will be moved to the second half of next year.

The EBShield Study is a global, multi‑center, randomized, double‑blind, placebo‑controlled pivotal Phase 2/3 trial (Part A) with an open‑label extension (Part B), enrolling 81 EBS participants. Patients applied AC‑203 once daily for 8 weeks, after which the primary efficacy endpoint was assessed. The primary endpoint was defined as the proportion of subjects achieving an Investigator Global Assessment (IGA) score of 0–1 at week 8.

According to the primary efficacy analysis, although the difference between the AC‑203 and placebo arms did not reach statistical significance, all efficacy measures and subgroup analyses showed a consistent advantage for the treatment arm. Moreover, pain and itch severity were significantly lower than placebo.

Wu Yijun said the company plans to hold consultation meetings with the U.S. FDA and the European EMA in Q1 2027 and is actively pursuing regulatory pathways to obtain marketing approval. She added that if the feedback is positive, the company aims to submit a formal application in the second half of next year and obtain U.S. and EU approvals in 2028.

Shareholders also asked whether the company has sufficient funds if the FDA or EMA request additional trials. Wu replied that the company is communicating with regulators on the premise of not conducting further trials; if additional studies are required, costs will be tightly controlled. She noted that the EBShield Study was kept under US$15 million and believes any extra work could be funded below that amount.

Regarding financing, Wu said Ancheng Biotech has just completed a cash‑raising round and holds more than NT$400 million in cash, with monthly operating expenses of about NT$4 million. She also mentioned that major shareholder Chen Zhiming continues to provide support.

items.title: 〈焦點股〉東方風能高毛利船舶本季陸續交付 股價亮燈漲停
items.title_en: Focus Stock: Dongfang Wind Power’s High‑Margin Vessels Delivered This Quarter, Stock Lights Up Hitting Limit‑Up
paras: 東方風能(7786-TW)5艘大型新船舶將於本季開始至2028年陸續交付並投入營運，其中，本季將交付1艘運維船，有助高毛利業務發展，激勵東方風能無懼今(19)日無懼大盤走弱，一度觸及漲停。
東方風能早盤以114元開平盤，雖一度翻黑跌至113.5元，不過隨後翻紅走高，並觸及漲停價125元，截至11點，股價暫報122元，漲幅超過7%，同步收復季線與半年線，成交量約500張。三大法人也連續4個交易日買超，合計買超186張。
東方風能9月營收13.42億元，月減14.11%，年增2.2%；第三季營收44.08億元，季增2.65%，年增9.22%；累計今年前三季營收104.75億元，年增24.74%。
東方風能除本季將交付1艘運維船，9月底抵台的新造運維船「東方先進」也將於11月1日投入12年期風機運維服務。另外，第四季開始東方海威將服務挪威、英國及德國離岸風電天然氣及海底基礎建設市場，將進一步挹注營運。法人也預估，東方風年今年有望賺逾1個股本。
paras_en: Dongfang Wind Power (7786‑TW) will begin delivering five large new vessels this quarter, with deliveries continuing through 2028. This quarter includes the handover of one operations‑and‑maintenance (O&M) vessel, which will boost its high‑margin business and gave the company confidence to ignore today’s (19th) market weakness, pushing the stock up to the limit‑up price at one point.

The stock opened flat at NT$114 in early trading, briefly dipped into the red to NT$113.5, but then turned green and rose to the limit‑up price of NT$125. By 11:00 a.m. it was quoted at NT$122, up more than 7%, reclaiming both its quarterly and semi‑annual moving averages, with volume around 500 lots. The three major institutional investors have been net buyers for four consecutive trading days, buying a total of 186 lots.

Dongfang Wind Power reported September revenue of NT$13.42 billion, down 14.11% month‑over‑month but up 2.2% year‑over‑year. Third‑quarter revenue was NT$44.08 billion, up 2.65% from the previous quarter and 9.22% year‑over‑year. Cumulative revenue for the first three quarters of the year reached NT$104.75 billion, a 24.74% increase year‑over‑year.

In addition to delivering one O&M vessel this quarter, the newly built O&M vessel “Dongfang Advanced,” which arrived in Taiwan at the end of September, will commence a 12‑year wind‑turbine O&M service on November 1. Starting in Q4, Dongfang Haiwei will begin serving offshore wind, gas, and subsea infrastructure markets in Norway, the United Kingdom and Germany, further bolstering operations. Analysts also estimate that Dongfang Wind could earn more than one times its share capital this year.

items.title: 三顧營運報喜！雙引擎策略發威 全年力拚轉虧為盈
items.title_en: Three-Gu Reports Operational Success! Dual-Engine Strategy Takes Off, Aiming to Turn Losses into Profit for the Full Year
paras: 再生醫療大廠三顧(3224-TW)於（15）日召開法人說明會，董事長陳宗基指出，再生醫療產業迎來法規與市場需求雙重變化，三顧（3224-TW）積極布局細胞治療製造、智慧化生產及國際技術合作，從傳統研發模式走向具備規模化生產能力的再生醫療平台。
董事長陳宗基指出，台灣生技產業若要與國際接軌，除了投入新藥研發，更重要的是建立符合國際標準的製造能力，讓海外最新技術與產品能在台灣落地，並透過CDMO（委託開發暨製造服務）模式創造新的營收來源。
電子部門AI零組件加持 全年營收獲利看旺
在營運績效方面，三顧展現出極強的韌性。陳宗基透露，隨著AI應用從雲端延伸至更多終端及連接需求，電子部門專注於AI零組件，直接與國際大廠合作，附加價值與毛利率大幅攀升。電子部門帶來的穩定現金流，成為支撐生醫事業研發與資本投入的堅實後盾。
三顧今年上半年虧損大幅收窄至僅約6百萬元，相較去年同期虧損的5千6百萬元已有大幅顯著改善。隨著第三季營收升溫與年初已經完成的 3.65 億元私募現增挹注資本，全年極有機會扭轉乾坤、實現轉虧為盈，達成對股東的承諾。
生醫雙引擎啟動 攜手正揚搶攻乾眼症龐大商機
生醫事業群方面，三顧正加速實現商業化落地的目標。三顧與正揚生醫持續推進乾眼症再生醫療製劑戰略合作，該產品已在美國進入臨床三期，預計將在台灣落地申請藥證，其中，相關血小板裂解液原料可朝細胞培養用途發展，另一項則涉及乾眼症治療產品的臨床與製造需求，將全數由三顧承接並開始出貨，成為營收成長的新動能。
據 GlobalData 報告預估，2018 至 2028 年全球乾眼症藥物市場將以 10.6% 的年複合成長率（CAGR）持續擴增，至 2028 年市場規模最高可達 107 億美元（折合新台幣約 3,400 億元）。
此外，因應全球 2028 年起陸續禁止使用胎牛血清（FBS）於細胞治療產品的法規趨勢，三顧利用 PIC/S GMP 認證廠房生產人類血小板裂解液，作為細胞培養基原料，並已開始第一批出貨。在幹細胞儲存領域，三顧更是繼日本京都大學 CiRA 之後，全台首家推出「家族多功能幹細胞（iPSC）儲存服務」的商業機構，與國際同步。
再生醫療法助攻 樂迦打造智慧細胞工廠打入國際大廠供應鏈
隨著台灣《再生醫療法》立法通過，國際前沿技術來台落地的門檻大為降低。三顧旗下的樂迦再生(6891-TW)擁有 6,000 坪立體化智慧工廠，並結合三顧近 10 年積累的專利演算法與智慧化數位部門，建構起極高的 AI 自動化製造護城河。
目前樂迦已成功取得德國 Miltenyi雙靶點 CAR-T 技術授權製造，並獲得美國 Charles River、澳洲Cambium Bio 等國際大廠委託合作。其中，與 Cambium Bio 的合作更可望讓樂迦成為台灣首家，在細胞治療領域獲得美國 FDA 親自來台查廠的細胞治療 CDMO 工廠。
在細胞治療領域，樂迦亦持續拓展國際合作機會，並與海外業者洽談技術與製造合作。陳宗基認為，再生醫療產品與傳統藥品的生產模式不同，具有少量多樣、製程複雜及品質要求高等的特性，若能建立完整的製造與管理系統，將有機會形成較高的產業進入門檻。
從研發走向製造　GMP與智慧工廠建立競爭門檻
陳宗基表示，三顧自2013年布局生醫事業以來，核心策略並非只追求單一產品開發，而是從細胞治療的製造端建立產業基礎。公司於2020年透過日本臨床合作經驗，推進細胞治療製造與國際規範接軌，並逐步累積製程及品質管理經驗。
隨著細胞治療走向商業化，製程一致性、品質控管、廠區管理與生產效率，將成為產業能否擴大規模的關鍵。三顧與旗下樂迦再生科技分工布局，由三顧聚焦研發與技術整合，樂迦則發展細胞製造及CDMO服務，藉此承接國際業者的技術導入與生產需求。
公司也持續推動智慧工廠及數位雙生概念，將製程資料、設備運作與品質管理導入數位化架構。陳宗基指出，AI在製造端的價值不只是導入軟體，而是讓第一線工程與製程人員具備AI應用能力，將實際生產問題轉化為可持續改善的流程，並在兼顧資料安全與營業機密的前提下，累積可用於製程優化的資料資產。
陳宗基強調，三顧集團專注於提供先進的 GMP 製造與研發平台。未來三顧將持續透過再生醫療公會串聯國內外產業鏈，結合雲端與地端技術，引領台灣生技產業走向工業化與國際化生產的新時代。
展望後市，在電子部門穩健貢獻與生醫 CDMO（委託開發暨製造服務）效益顯現下，公司營運擺脫虧損陰霾，全年有機會實現轉虧為盈；旗下子公司樂迦再生(6891-TW)更打造亞洲首座 AI 原生細胞工廠，展現強勁的國際接軌實力。
paras_en: Regenerative medicine giant Three-Gu (3224-TW) held a corporate briefing on the 15th, where Chairman Chen Zong-ji said the regenerative medicine industry is undergoing both regulatory and market demand shifts, and Three-Gu is actively positioning itself in cell‑therapy manufacturing, smart production, and international technology collaborations, moving from a traditional R&D model to a regenerative‑medicine platform with scalable production capability.

Chairman Chen emphasized that for Taiwan’s biotech sector to align with the world, it must not only invest in new‑drug R&D but also build manufacturing capacity that meets international standards, allowing the latest overseas technologies and products to be realized in Taiwan and creating new revenue streams through a CDMO (contract development and manufacturing services) model.
Electronics Division Boosted by AI Components, Forecasts Strong Full‑Year Revenue and Profit

In terms of operating performance, Three‑Gu has shown remarkable resilience. Chen disclosed that as AI applications expand from the cloud to more endpoints and connectivity needs, the electronics division, focused on AI components, is partnering directly with global giants, driving a sharp rise in added value and gross margins. The steady cash flow from this division provides a solid backstop for biotech R&D and capital investment.

Three‑Gu’s first‑half loss narrowed dramatically to about NT$6 million, a stark improvement from the NT$5.6 billion loss in the same period last year. With third‑quarter revenue warming up and a private placement of NT$365 million completed earlier this year, the company has a strong chance to reverse its fortunes and achieve profitability for the year, fulfilling its commitment to shareholders.
Biotech Dual‑Engine Activated, Partnering with Zheng‑Yang to Pursue the Vast Dry‑Eye Market

In the biotech business group, Three‑Gu is accelerating the commercialization of its offerings. The firm continues its strategic partnership with Zheng‑Yang Biotech on a regenerative‑medicine formulation for dry‑eye disease, which has entered Phase III trials in the United States and is expected to seek Taiwanese drug approval. The related platelet‑lysate raw material can be developed for cell‑culture use, while another component addresses clinical and manufacturing needs for dry‑eye treatment; Three‑Gu will handle the entire production and begin shipments, creating a new revenue driver.

According to a GlobalData report, the global dry‑eye drug market is projected to grow at a 10.6% compound annual growth rate from 2018 to 2028, reaching up to US$10.7 billion (approximately NT$340 billion) by 2028.

Furthermore, in response to the upcoming global ban on fetal bovine serum (FBS) for cell‑therapy products starting in 2028, Three‑Gu uses its PIC/S‑GMP‑certified facility to produce human platelet‑lysate as a cell‑culture medium ingredient and has already shipped the first batch. In the stem‑cell storage arena, Three‑Gu became the first Taiwanese commercial entity—following Japan’s Kyoto University CiRA—to offer a “family‑focused multifunctional iPSC storage service,” aligning with international standards.
Regenerative‑Medicine Act Boosts Le‑Ga’s Smart Cell Factory Entry into International Supplier Chains

With the passage of Taiwan’s Regenerative Medicine Act, the barrier for cutting‑edge foreign technologies to be introduced locally has dropped significantly. Le‑Ga Regenerative (6891‑TW), a subsidiary of Three‑Gu, operates a 6,000‑ping three‑dimensional smart factory and leverages nearly a decade of proprietary algorithms and digital expertise to build a strong AI‑driven manufacturing moat.

Le‑Ga has already secured licensing to manufacture Germany’s Miltenyi dual‑target CAR‑T technology and has received contract work from U.S. firm Charles River, Australia’s Cambium Bio, and other global players. The partnership with Cambium Bio could make Le‑Ga the first Taiwanese cell‑therapy CDMO to host an on‑site FDA inspection from the United States.

In the cell‑therapy space, Le‑Ga continues to expand international collaborations and is negotiating technology and manufacturing agreements with overseas partners. Chen notes that regenerative‑medicine products differ from traditional drugs in being low‑volume, high‑variety, process‑intensive, and subject to stringent quality demands; establishing a comprehensive manufacturing and management system can create high entry barriers for the industry.
From R&D to Manufacturing – GMP and Smart Factories Build Competitive Barriers

Chen said that since Three‑Gu entered the biotech arena in 2013, its core strategy has never been to chase a single product but to build an industry foundation from the manufacturing side of cell therapy. In 2020, leveraging experience from Japanese clinical collaborations, the company advanced cell‑therapy manufacturing to align with international standards and gradually accumulated process and quality‑management expertise.

As cell therapy moves toward commercialization, consistency of process, quality control, plant management, and production efficiency will determine whether the industry can scale. Three‑Gu and its Le‑Ga subsidiary divide responsibilities: Three‑Gu focuses on R&D and technology integration, while Le‑Ga develops cell manufacturing and CDMO services, thereby handling international partners’ technology transfer and production needs.

The company also pushes forward smart‑factory and digital‑twin concepts, digitizing process data, equipment operation, and quality management. Chen highlighted that AI’s value on the manufacturing floor goes beyond software deployment; it equips frontline engineers and process staff with AI capabilities, turning real‑world production issues into continuously improvable workflows while safeguarding data security and business confidentiality, and building a data asset pool for process optimization.

Chen emphasized that the Three‑Gu Group is dedicated to providing advanced GMP manufacturing and R&D platforms. Going forward, the group will continue to link domestic and overseas industry chains through the Regenerative Medicine Association, combining cloud and on‑site technologies to usher Taiwan’s biotech sector into a new era of industrialized and internationally‑oriented production.

Looking ahead, with the electronics division’s solid contribution and the emerging benefits of biotech CDMO services, the company expects to shed its loss‑laden shadow and has a realistic chance to turn a profit for the full year. Its subsidiary Le‑Ga Regenerative (6891‑TW) is also building Asia’s first AI‑native cell factory, showcasing strong capabilities for international integration.

(圖片來源：優分析產業資料庫)
AI、車用、航太衛星三引擎，AI占比三級跳
AI營收占比由2025年不到5%，2026年第一季的12%，前三季已達13%，產品直接設計進美系雲端大廠的認證名單。
車用占比由2025年的53%降至前三季的44%，但這是因為AI成長更快，絕對金額仍隨車用回溫而增加。
航太衛星方面，高階精密薄膜電阻出貨強勁，這類產品毛利率均在80%以上，是毛利率跳升的隱形關鍵。
產能從5.5億顆擴到8.5億顆，優先配置高毛利應用
精密電阻月產能目前約5.5億顆，產能利用率滿載，訂單出貨比約1.5，平均交期25週，1206尺寸的排程已排到2027年下半年。
第四季與2027年第一季各增5,000萬顆，月產能提升至6.5億顆；2027年中至2028年初在中國南通建新廠，第一期可容納2億顆月產能，總投資約8億元，以自有資金搭配銀行融資。公司強調新增產能優先配置工控、AI及航太等高毛利應用，而非追求出貨總量。
(圖片來源：優分析產業資料庫)
風險提醒：漲價延續性取決於一線大廠是否跟進
中國6至7家中小型電阻廠因低價競爭不堪虧損，規劃減產，供給端收斂有利價格，但若一線大廠未跟進漲價，價格能否延續仍需觀察。
此外預估值短期內上修幅度很大，後續若漲價效益或AI訂單不如預期，與法人期待之間可能出現落差。

paras_en: October 19, 2026 (U-Analysis/Industry Data Center report) – Guangjie’s 2025 revenue grew only 4% year‑over‑year with a budget achievement rate of 84%, but in 2026 it completely reversed course under the dual engines of AI and price hikes.

Second‑quarter revenue rose 22.9% sequentially and 26.8% year‑over‑year, with a gross margin of 32.79%; third‑quarter revenue rose 22.8% sequentially and 58.4% year‑over‑year, with analysts estimating a gross margin of 37.9%.
September revenue increased 3.57% month‑over‑month and 67.43% year‑over‑year; cumulative revenue for the first three quarters grew 34.83% year‑over‑year, reaching a new high for the same period.

Compared with the May investor briefing that only mentioned a possible 15% full‑year revenue growth, analysts have now revised the full‑year estimate up to 42%‑43.8% growth, nearly tripling the five‑month forecast, and gross‑margin expectations have also risen above 35%.
(Image source: U‑Analysis industry database)
Price increases are applied by product line and in batches, with benefits lagging one to two quarters.

What’s truly noteworthy is that this price hike is not a one‑time adjustment: by October roughly half of the products had completed the increase, ranging from 20% to 30%, with certain items accumulating 30%‑35% hikes, lifting the average selling price by about 10%.
Because the adjustments target newly received orders, the benefit lags one to two quarters, beginning to appear from July and fully reflected in September‑October.

The company notes that the tight supply‑demand balance for high‑end precision resistors will continue at least through 2027, and peers are also raising prices in 2026, indicating an industry‑wide structural shift rather than a single‑company action; meanwhile, the decline in precious‑metal prices such as silver and palladium further improves cost structure.
(Image source: U‑Analysis industry database)
Three engines: AI, automotive, aerospace‑satellite, with AI’s share jumping dramatically

AI revenue share rose from less than 5% in 2025 to 12% in Q1 2026 and has already reached 13% for the first three quarters, with products directly listed on major U.S. cloud providers’ certification rosters.
Automotive’s share fell from 53% in 2025 to 44% for the first three quarters, but this reflects AI’s faster growth; the absolute amount still rose as automotive demand warmed.
In aerospace‑satellite, shipments of high‑end precision thin‑film resistors are strong; these products enjoy gross margins above 80%, serving as a hidden driver of margin expansion.
Capacity expands from 550 million pieces to 850 million pieces, prioritized for high‑margin applications

Current monthly capacity for precision resistors is about 550 million pieces, operating at full utilization, with an order‑to‑shipment ratio of roughly 1.5, an average lead time of 25 weeks, and the 1206 size schedule already booked through the second half of 2027.

An additional 50 million pieces will be added in Q4 and Q1 2027, raising monthly capacity to 650 million pieces; a new plant in Nantong, China, slated for mid‑2027 to early‑2028, will provide a first phase of 200 million pieces per month, with total investment of about NT$8 billion funded by internal cash and bank financing. The company stresses that the new capacity will be allocated first to industrial‑control, AI and aerospace – high‑margin uses – rather than sheer volume.
(Image source: U‑Analysis industry database)
Risk reminder: Continuation of price hikes depends on whether leading manufacturers follow suit

Six to seven small‑ and medium‑size resistor makers in China are planning production cuts due to unsustainable low‑price competition, tightening supply and supporting prices; however, if leading manufacturers do not follow the price hikes, the sustainability of higher prices remains uncertain.
Moreover, short‑term upward revisions of estimates are large; if price‑hike benefits or AI orders fall short of expectations, a gap may emerge between actual results and analyst forecasts.

items.title: 時碩工業(4566)連四月營收創高！AI水冷從送樣走到量產，20億元年單能撐多久？
items.title_en: Shih-Shuo Industrial (4566) Sets Four-Month Revenue Record in April! AI Water Cooling Moves from Sample to Production, How Long Can a 2 Billion NTD Annual Order Sustain?
paras: 2026年10月19日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ 時碩工業2025年受新台幣急升影響，獲利減少，全年每股盈餘僅1.36元，2026年靠AI伺服器水冷散熱專案翻身。
6至9月營收連四個月改寫歷史新高：7月5.55億元、8月5.96億元（年增53.95%）、9月再月增12%、年增45%。
第三季營收季增24%、年增43%，前9月累計營收46.4億元、年增23%，已達2025年全年的93%，法人看好全年挑戰60億元。
(圖片來源：優分析產業資料庫)
水冷散熱7月正式量產，年單約20億元
真正值得注意的是，公司切入日系系統廠的AI伺服器供應鏈，供應水冷散熱系統的快接頭、L型彎頭、液冷板等十多個料號，年單金額約20億元，出貨排程延續至2027年上半年。
出貨節奏上，6月起小量出貨，8至9月進入高峰，10月起營收迎來高峰，下半年散熱占比達雙位數。
公司7月法說會也釋出2027年散熱加機器人營收占比上看20%的說法，屬於公司與法人的預期，尚待實際出貨驗證。
機器人與航太同步發力，產品結構逐步位移
機器人方面，公司已切入中國諧波減速機廠供應鏈，有2家機器人關鍵零組件客戶，聚焦具身機器人關節模組，累計十多個料號。
航太上半年占營收17%至18%、年增20%，中期目標提升至20%，子公司天陽航太7月完成增資，規劃2027年公開發行、2028年上市櫃。
磁浮壓縮機已建2條專線，2027年規劃增設第三條，單線最大年產值約2億元。
(圖片來源：優分析產業資料庫)
泰國廠擴編投資，同步發行可轉債募資
泰國廠投資金額由原先4.5億泰銖，在2025年5月上調至10億泰銖，增加逾一倍，實際2026年3月底才試營運，預計10月20日舉行啟用典禮，初期生產車用與工業零件，未來導入航太。
公司董事會並決議發行上限10億元、3年期的第四次無擔保可轉換公司債，預計第三季底至第四季初完成。
風險提醒：散熱營收高度集中單一客戶，泰國廠航太認證仍待驗證
現階段散熱營收高度集中在單一日系客戶的專案，2027年上半年交付完畢後，下一世代訂單能否無縫接軌是關鍵。
航太認證涉及特定廠址、設備與製程，泰國新產線不等於自動取得量產資格，後續須觀察客戶驗證與實際出貨；此外泰國廠原規劃2025年下半年開出，實際延後至2026年，進度曾有落差。
(圖片來源：優分析產業資料庫)

paras_en: On October 19, 2026 (Yuan Analysis/Industry Data Center Report) – Shih‑Shuo Industrial’s 2025 earnings were hit by a sharp rise in New Taiwan Dollars, reducing profitability to a diluted EPS of only 1.36 NTD. In 2026, the company turned around thanks to its AI server water‑cooling heat‑sink project.

Revenue from June to September broke new records for four consecutive months: 555.5 million NTD in July, 596 million NTD in August (53.95% year‑over‑year growth), and September saw a 12% monthly increase and 45% year‑over‑year growth.

Q3 revenue grew 24% quarter‑over‑quarter and 43% year‑over‑year; cumulative revenue for the first nine months reached 4.64 billion NTD, up 23% year‑over‑year, already accounting for 93% of 2025’s total. Analysts are optimistic about reaching a 6‑billion‑NTD target for the full year.
(Image source: Yuan Analysis Industry Database)
Water‑cooling heat‑sink production officially began in July, with an annual order volume of about 2 billion NTD.

What’s truly noteworthy is that the company has entered the AI server supply chain of Japanese system manufacturers, supplying quick‑connect fittings, L‑shaped elbows, liquid‑cooling plates, and more than ten other part numbers for water‑cooling systems. The annual order value is roughly 2 billion NTD, with shipment schedules extending into the first half of 2027.

In terms of shipment rhythm, small volumes began in June, peaked in August and September, and revenue reached a peak from October onward. In the second half of the year, the share of cooling revenue reached double digits.

During the July earnings conference call, the company also disclosed that it expects cooling and robotics revenue to account for about 20% of 2027’s total, a view shared by both the company and analysts, pending actual shipment verification.
Robotics and aerospace are advancing in tandem, gradually shifting the product mix.

In robotics, the company has entered the supply chain of a Chinese harmonic reducer manufacturer, with two key robotics component customers focusing on embodied robot joint modules, covering more than ten part numbers.

In aerospace, the first half of the year accounted for 17% to 18% of revenue with a 20% year‑over‑year increase; the mid‑term goal is to raise this to 20%. Subsidiary Tianyang Aerospace completed a capital increase in July, planning a public offering in 2027 and a listing in 2028.
Two dedicated lines for magnetic‑levitation compressors have been built; a third line is planned for 2027, with each line’s maximum annual output value around 200 million NTD.
(Image source: Yuan Analysis Industry Database)
Thai plant expansion investment and simultaneous issuance of convertible bonds for fundraising.

The investment in the Thai plant was originally 450 million Thai baht, increased to 1 billion Thai baht in May 2025, more than doubling the amount. Operations began only at the end of March 2026, with an inauguration ceremony scheduled for October 20. Initial production focuses on automotive and industrial parts, with future aerospace integration planned.
The board of directors has also decided to issue up to 1 billion NTD of unsecured convertible bonds with a three‑year term, expected to be completed between the end of Q3 and the beginning of Q4.
Risk warning: Cooling revenue is highly concentrated with a single customer, and aerospace certification for the Thai plant remains to be verified.

At present, cooling revenue is highly concentrated on a single Japanese customer’s project. After delivery is completed in the first half of 2027, the ability to seamlessly transition to the next generation of orders will be critical.

Aerospace certification involves specific plant sites, equipment, and processes. The new Thai production line does not automatically qualify for mass production; subsequent customer verification and actual shipments must be observed. Additionally, the Thai plant was originally planned to start in the second half of 2025 but was actually delayed to 2026, showing a gap in progress.
(Image source: Yuan Analysis Industry Database)

items.title_en: Focus Stock: Fu Chiao’s New Plant in Thailand Breaks Out, Surges to Limit‑Up with Record High Price
paras: 玻纖一貫廠富喬工業 (1815-TW) 在泰國的投資已經啟動，富喬於泰國北柳府 Apex Green 工業園第一期新廠已經動土，今(19)日股價受到買盤青睞，盤中爆出 18.6 萬張強大量能，一度站上154元漲停價，創新天價。
富喬本次在泰國總投資金額約 31 億元，產能皆己被客戶訂滿。泰國新廠將導入先進製程，主要生產高階玻纖布產品，應用涵蓋 AI 伺服器、低軌衛星、IC 載板等相關領域。新廠預計於 2027 年第三季量產。
富喬2026年第二季營收21.31億元，毛利率39.97%，季增4個百分點，年增15.42個百分點，稅後純益8.43億元，季增84.01%，較去年同期由虧轉盈，單季每股純益達1.45元。
2026年1-6月富喬營收40.12億元，毛利率38.09%，年增10.99個百分點，稅後純益13億元，年增8.31倍，每股純益達2.24元 。
paras_en: Fiberglass integrated plant Fu Chiao Industrial (1815‑TW) has started its investment in Thailand. Fu Chiao has broken ground on its Phase 1 new plant at the Apex Green Industrial Park in Nakhon Luang Province, Thailand. On the 19th, the stock was favored by buyers, surging with a massive 186,000‑share order, briefly hitting the T+20% limit‑up at NT$154, setting a new record high price.

The total investment in Thailand is about NT$3.1 billion, and the capacity has already been fully booked by customers. The new plant will adopt advanced processes, mainly producing high‑end fiberglass cloth products for applications such as AI servers, low‑Earth‑orbit satellites, and IC substrates. The plant is expected to start mass production in Q3 2027.

In Q2 2026, Fu Chiao recorded revenue of NT$2.131 billion, gross margin 39.97%, up 4 percentage points quarter‑over‑quarter and 15.42 percentage points year‑over‑year. Net profit after tax was NT$843 million, up 84.01% quarter‑over‑quarter, turning from a loss to a profit year‑over‑year, with earnings per share of NT$1.45 for the quarter.

For the first half of 2026, Fu Chiao's revenue was NT$4.012 billion, gross margin 38.09%, up 10.99 percentage points year‑over‑year, net profit after tax NT$1.3 billion, up 8.31‑fold year‑over‑year, with earnings per share of NT$2.24.

items.title: 光寶科(2301)第三季營收創39季新高！800VDC時程提前，2027年才是真正的放量年？
items.title_en: Opto22 (2301) Q3 Revenue Hits 39‑Quarter High! 800 VDC Timeline Accelerated, 2027 Is the Real Expansion Year?
paras: 2026年10月19日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ 光寶科AI電源動能持續加溫，第三季營收574億元，季增9%、年增28%，為39季以來新高，9月營收188億元，年增22%。
第二季營收527億元，季增21%、年增30%，毛利率27.2%、營益率15.6%，每股盈餘3.14元，單季獲利創歷史新高。
AI營收占比2025年約20%，第二季已突破25%，全年目標30%，管理層認為仍有上修空間。
(圖片來源：優分析產業資料庫)
成長主要來自規格升級，而非單純出貨量增加
真正值得注意的是，這波成長的關鍵在單機價值跳升：電源供應器由3至5kW拉升至8kW，下一代達18.3kW；機架式電源從33kW推進至110kW；50V、500kW的電源機櫃第一季少量出貨、第二季放量，800VDC、1.5MW規格則進入驗證。
同樣一顆電源，單價是過去的數倍，營收結構與獲利品質同步改善，也解釋了為何毛利率與營益率創高、營收規模卻尚未回到歷史峰值。
電池備援模組產能開出後，9月雲端及物聯網部門營收占比已衝上59%、年增逾五成。
800VDC時程提前一至兩季，ASIC客戶率先導入
800VDC樣機8月完成驗證，預計11月小量出貨、2027年第一季放量，較原規劃提前約一至兩季；ASIC客戶的進度快於GPU客戶，GPU平台最快2027年第二季才啟動。
目前兩家美系雲端業者已開始出貨電源與機櫃，公司目標單一關鍵客戶達10億美元營收，未來12至18個月有望再打入兩家大型雲端業者。
資本支出連三次上修，產能效益要等2027年
2026年資本支出規劃先是180億元，7月再加上德州新廠約295億元，10月又追加高雄擴產88.5億元。
高雄二期第三季投產、越南廣寧廠第四季投產，德州廠2027年上半年才量產高壓直流與電池備援模組；非中國產能占比2026年底將超過60%、2027年達70%。
公司2026年才進入資本支出高峰，今年營收成長靠的是既有產線的規格升級與組合優化，真正的新產能放量要等到2027年。
(圖片來源：優分析產業資料庫)
併購補齊電源、液冷、光通訊三塊拼圖
公司斥資3,430萬美元取得DenseLight 21.22%股權，切入磷化銦雷射晶片與共封裝光學引擎，預計2027年下半年至2028年上半年貢獻營收；另斥資1.76億美元取得DCX 25%股權，取得600kW至16MW的液冷技術，補齊資料中心散熱。
風險提醒：第二季毛利率含一次性因素，非每季都維持27%
第二季毛利率季增5.5個百分點，主因產品組合轉佳、存貨跌價迴轉與高階機種出貨遞延，管理層指出上半年24.7%才是合理基準，長期目標25%，並非每季都維持27%。
此外記憶體、處理器等零組件成本通膨與缺料，可能壓抑非AI產品的毛利，資本支出大幅上修後的折舊與投資壓力也要持續追蹤。
(圖片來源：優分析產業資料庫)

paras_en: On October 19, 2026 (Yuan Analysis/Industry Data Center Report) – Opto22’s AI power solutions continue to heat up, with Q3 revenue of 57.4 billion NTD, a 9% quarter‑on‑quarter increase and a 28% year‑on‑year rise, marking a new high in 39 quarters. September revenue was 18.8 billion NTD, up 22% year‑on‑year.

Q2 revenue was 52.7 billion NTD, a 21% quarter‑on‑quarter rise and a 30% year‑on‑year increase. Gross margin was 27.2% and operating margin 15.6%. Earnings per share were 3.14 NTD, a single‑quarter profit record.
AI revenue accounted for about 20% in 2025, already surpassed 25% in Q2, with an annual target of 30%. Management believes there is still upside potential.
(Image source: Yuan Analysis Industry Database)
Growth mainly comes from specification upgrades rather than mere volume increases.

The real highlight is the price jump per unit: power supplies rose from 3–5 kW to 8 kW, with next‑gen reaching 18.3 kW; rack‑mount supplies moved from 33 kW to 110 kW; 50 V, 500 kW power cabinets had limited Q1 shipments but ramped up in Q2, while 800 VDC and 1.5 MW specs entered verification.

The same power supply now sells for multiple times its past price, improving revenue structure and profit quality, explaining why gross and operating margins hit highs while revenue scale hasn’t yet returned to historic peaks.
After battery backup module capacity opened, cloud and IoT divisions’ revenue share hit 59% in September, up more than 50% year‑on‑year.
800 VDC timeline accelerated by one to two quarters, ASIC customers lead the way.

800 VDC prototypes were verified in August, with small shipments expected in November and volume ramp‑up in Q1 2027, about one to two quarters ahead of the original plan. ASIC customers progress faster than GPU customers, whose platform will not launch until Q2 2027 at the earliest.

Two U.S. cloud vendors have already begun shipping power supplies and cabinets. The company aims for 1 billion USD revenue from a single key customer and expects to win two more large cloud vendors in the next 12–18 months.
Capital expenditures have been revised upward three times; capacity benefits will only materialize in 2027.
In 2026, capital spending was planned at 18 billion NTD, with an additional 29.5 billion NTD for a new Texas plant in July, and 8.85 billion NTD added in October for a Kaohsiung expansion.

Kaohsiung Phase II will start production in Q3, Vietnam’s Guangning plant in Q4, and the Texas plant will only begin mass‑producing high‑voltage DC and battery backup modules in H1 2027. Non‑China capacity will exceed 60% by end‑2026 and reach 70% in 2027.

The company only enters its capital‑expenditure peak in 2026; this year’s revenue growth relies on upgrading existing lines and optimizing combinations. Real new capacity ramp‑up will wait until 2027.
(Image source: Yuan Analysis Industry Database)
Acquisitions complete the power, liquid cooling, and optical communication puzzle.

The company spent 34.3 million USD to acquire a 21.22% stake in DenseLight, entering phosphide indium‑radium laser chips and co‑packaged optical engines, expected to contribute revenue from H2 2027 to H1 2028. It also spent 176 million USD for a 25% stake in DCX, gaining 600 kW to 16 MW liquid‑cooling technology to complete data‑center cooling.
Risk warning: Q2 gross margin includes one‑time factors and may not stay at 27% every quarter.

Q2 gross margin rose 5.5 percentage points, mainly due to a better product mix, inventory write‑down reversal, and delayed shipments of high‑end models. Management notes that 24.7% in the first half is a realistic baseline, with a long‑term target of 25%, and that 27% is not sustainable each quarter.

Additionally, inflation and shortages in memory, processors, and other components may squeeze non‑AI product margins. The significant capital‑expenditure hike means depreciation and investment pressure will need continuous monitoring.
